description:
Generate an AI book cover image using FLUX. Describe your vision, pick a genre, and get a portrait JPEG cover — 768×1152 when the model honours the requested size, otherwise its default square. The AI enhances your prompt with professional composition guidance while preserving your creative vision.

Pro only ($9/mo). Upgrade at https://epublys.com/pricing

author.description: Author name (for context, not rendered on cover)

description.description: Creative description of the desired book cover (max 2000 chars). Either description or title is required.

genre.description: Book genre — affects style and composition

title.description: Book title — used to synthesize a cover concept when no description is given (not rendered on cover)

name: generate_cover
